examples.pie: h₂énHe wósr̥ gʷegʷóme? népot ne gʷegʷóme. snóygʷʰos h₂éǵroysu éti légʰeti. h₂óweyes nos dʰǵʰyés h₃l̥h₁ént. wóydh₂e. h₁íh₂n̥s h₂éyeri ḱlḗm. méromes? ne méromes. sóh₂wl̥ gʷʰréh₁yeti h₁yégos-kʷe tinh₁tór.

examples.pie: wíHre bʰudʰdʰí. ḱwónes yuǵHént. ḱoph₂óns dʰéyǵʰesi h₁épi ḱlush₁yóh₂. téḱneh₂ sl̥h₂gʷdʰí gʷowsth₂óy-kʷe kudʰsó. somHós túH wikési? bʰréh₂tr̥bʰis moy ḱóm wikóh₂. nu pótni dr̥mdʰí. pótey te deywṓs ph₂sih₁ént.

examples.pie: h₁yód h₂nḗr towdósyo kʷékʷlom Hrunépeti nu h₁ésmey yugóm sh₂imónm̥-kʷe h₁opéyetu. h₁yód kʷékʷlos Hrunépetor nu towdós h₁ím h₂ew démetu h₁ésmey-kʷe kʷis mē kʷéyet.
examples.en: If a man breaks the wheel of a driver, let him give the driver a yoke and a rope. If the wheel breaks, let the driver build it again, and let no one pay him.

examples.pie: h₁yód wĺ̥kʷos h₂ówim gʷr̥h₃ḗti poh₂imḗn-kʷe h₁íh₂m̥ ne h₂léksēti só h₃rēǵéy déḱm̥ pórḱons kʷéyetu. h₁yód-kʷe h₁íh₂m̥ h₂léksēti nu kʷid mē kʷéyet. h₁yód h₃érō pórḱom h₁épeti nu kʷid mē kʷéyet.
examples.en: If a wolf devours a sheep and the shepherd does not guard it, let that shepherd pay the king ten piglets. And if he guards it, let him pay nothing. If an eagle seizes a piglet, let him pay nothing.

examples.pie: h₁yós wóyḱosyo dʰéyǵʰos Hrunépeti nu só h₁íd h₂ew démetu. h₁yód snígʷʰs h₁íd gléwbʰēti nu kʷis mē kʷéyet. h₁yód ǵʰwḗr pótn̥yeh₂s ǵʰórtom dérēti nu h₁ím démetu. dʰéyǵʰos stéh₂eti h₁léwdʰerōs-kʷe h₁íd péh₂sonti.
examples.en: Whoever breaks the wall of the settlement, let that man build it again. But if the snow splits it, let no one pay. If a wild animal tears up the pen of a mistress, let her build it. The wall shall stand, and the free men shall guard it.
